name: WINNIE LEDGER
note:
THE ACTING TERRITORIAL ASSAYER, behind her counter. Doc 04's principal; doc 25's 'Not with her at the counter'. A CANDIDATE: her canonical design is art/staging/room-05/winnie-canonical-02.png (ledger: winnie attempt 3 -- one generation holding her rest pose and her two work poses, pointed at composition-master-02 after Tyler rejected master-01); every frame here is one of those three or is derived from one of them. Nothing in this file is Tyler-approved.

WHERE SHE STANDS. Behind the counter, in front of the shelves, at the ledger, x1010. TYLER'S COUNTER-CONTACT CORRECTION (2026-09-04): her runtime sheet is a BEHIND-COUNTER sheet (art/staging/room-05/winnie-02-counter/, derived from the lit five-frame sheet by tools/rig/winnie-counter.py with no pixel repainted): the figure is lowered 39px so her resting hands lie on the ledger's near page (hand bottom y401-402 against the page's y378-408) and the writing nib meets the page (y400-401); the body physically behind the ledger's far edge and the counter's back edge is matted out; the frames are cropped to what is drawn. `y` is therefore the row under her hands (404), not her feet -- the sheet has no feet. clipPlane 1 is now the cage bars only; the counter block that used to mask her from y395 down would have masked the hands. The ink stand is NOT in her frames any more: it is `props[0]`, one plate coordinate, pen in the stand while she rests (frames 0-1) and out of it while she writes or looks up (frames 2-4, where her hand holds it). Before the correction her hands stopped 16px above the ledger and the stand's base hung 29px above the counter.

WHAT SHE DOES. She writes. That is the occupation canon states outright -- WIN_B1: 'She stops writing. It is the first time she has stopped writing.' -- and the only one whose props are hers and nobody's puzzle. Breaks are a POOL chosen on an irregular cycle: a line written; a line written and the page checked; a line written and the pen set down; a glance up. Every break begins by taking the pen from the stand (frame 5) and ends by returning it (5, then 0), so the pen is always somewhere. Between breaks she breathes (frames 0 and 1). While her own tree is open she holds frame 4, looking up from the page -- doc 32 section 8.2, stillness is a performance state.

NOT a joke, not a clue, not a story fact: physical staging of a role canon already gave her (ruling 19). MOVED from x1080 to x1010 in the pilot (the brass cage post at x1075 ran through her centre), and to x1035 in correction 2 so her writing hand sits inside the ledger's page; the bars-only mask at x1035 leaves her face clear.

sprite.frameNote: 0 rest (pen in stand) · 1 breath (derived) · 2 writing · 3 writing, hand shifted two display pixels along the line (derived) · 4 looking up from the page. BEHIND-COUNTER SHEET (Tyler's counter-contact corrections 1 and 2, 2026-09-04): the lit five-frame sheet matted per column against the ledger's far edge and the counter's back edge, the working forearms/hands/pen kept whole ABOVE the surface and lifted a few whole pixels so paper shows under the hands, the pen shaft re-angled about its grip in the writing frames, the stand removed into its own prop, frames cropped to what is drawn. No pixel repainted; the slivers of dress the lifted forearms uncovered are filled from the torso column beside them and counted in frames.json.

props.note: THE INK STAND, a counter object: one plate coordinate, base on the counter surface, pen in the stand while she rests (frames 0-1) and out of it while her hand holds it (frames 2-4). Both states are cut from her rest frame by tools/rig/winnie-counter.py; the pot body is identical in both.
